Sections 1–2 are that day; section 3 looks forward 15 days from it. In section 1 ★ marks a named marquee investor in the allottee list, and says whether the allotment is proposed or done.
Section 3 — what the dates mean. BUY BY is the last day a purchase still settles in time to be on the register for a bonus, split or rights record date — one trading day before it, since a trade settles the next day. LAST DAY to trade is the close of a rights-entitlement window, after which the entitlement lapses. Unlocks are IPO lock-in tranches coming free, with the share count as a share of total listed shares. Ratios, premiums and face-value changes are quoted as the exchange states them; where an issue is at par it says so. Amounts and dates are as filed by the company or published by the exchange. Nothing here is advice.
